purpose: Attach the materials required to learn each hero's explicit Level2 awakening skill from the pinned UnityDataTool parsed ConfigData snapshot without inferred identity or relation edges.

relationContract.heroAwaken: hero-basic-combat.records[].heroId -> ConfigDataAwakenInfo.ID by explicit numeric equality
relationContract.awakeningSkill: ConfigDataAwakenInfo.Level2SkillID when it is a positive integer
relationContract.materialList: The same ConfigDataAwakenInfo row's Awaken2Material[] preserved in source order

normalizationRules: Consume only hero-basic-combat status PASS with the current canonical hero population.
Resolve ConfigDataAwakenInfo only by explicit hero ID equality.
A hero has a displayable awakening skill only when Level2SkillID is a positive integer.
Do not use Awaken2Unlock as the awakening-skill admission gate; it is preserved only as source evidence when present.
For a defined Level2SkillID, preserve Awaken2Material source order and require a non-empty material list.
Resolve items only when GoodsType is exactly 6 and only by explicit numeric ID equality to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID.
Do not join by names, numeric ranges, ID arithmetic, filename similarity, UI order, or historical output.
Do not synthesize Level2SkillID or materials for heroes where the source does not define them.
Fail closed on duplicate source IDs, malformed goods, missing AwakenInfo for a defined canonical relation, unresolved Item IDs, unsupported GoodsType, or generated/source mismatch.

PASS: The generated hero population exactly matches hero-basic-combat.
Each canonical hero is resolved only by heroId -> ConfigDataAwakenInfo.ID.
Each positive Level2SkillID preserves the same-row Awaken2Material list in source order.
Every material has GoodsType 6, positive integer Id and Count, and resolves exactly once to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID.
Heroes without a positive Level2SkillID remain explicit non-display records without inferred fallback.
FAIL: Any upstream, identity, cardinality, ordering, GoodsType, material count, Item snapshot, or source parity mismatch occurs.

completionRule: Run the producer against the current pinned ConfigData source-pack, then run the independent validator. Completion requires generated status PASS, summary status PASS, validator PASS, no hard errors, and no unexpected repository mutation.
